say:0:1322401001:0.text: I saw Captain Rodrigo just now... He looked terrible.
say:0:1322401001:0.source_cn: 我看到侍卫长罗德里戈了……他看上去可真憔悴。

say:1:1322401002:0.text: Let's go and check on him, Magister!
say:1:1322401002:0.source_cn: 我们过去看望下他吧，主人！
say:1:1322401002:0.male: Let's go and check on him, Magister!
say:1:1322401002:0.female: Let's go and check on him, Magister!

say:1:1322402001:1.text: I thought you had left the duchy. Is there something I can do for you?
say:1:1322402001:1.source_cn: 我以为您已经离开公国了，有什么可以为您效劳的吗？
say:1:1322402001:1.male: I thought you had left the duchy. Is there something I can do for you?
say:1:1322402001:1.female: I thought you had left the duchy. Is there something I can do for you?

say:4:1322402005:1.text: But now's not the time to wallow. With the fall of the Valesa family, Whiteridge is in chaos. I know I need to pull myself together—this place needs me more than ever.
say:4:1322402005:1.source_cn: 但现在不是放任悲伤的时候，瓦勒沙家族的败落让白山陷入混...
say:4:1322402005:1.male: But now's not the time to wallow. With the fall of the Valesa family, Whiteridge is in chaos. I know I need to pull myself together—this place needs me more than ever.
say:4:1322402005:1.female: But now's not the time to wallow. With the fall of the Valesa family, Whiteridge is in chaos. I know I need to pull myself together—this place needs me more than ever.

say:5:1322402006:1.text: But... what can I even do? The guards might not say it out loud, but we all know Whiteridge's problems are way beyond what I can handle.
say:5:1322402006:1.source_cn: 而我……又能做些什么呢……虽然侍卫们嘴上不说，他们都意...
say:5:1322402006:1.male: But... what can I even do? The guards might not say it out loud, but we all know Whiteridge's problems are way beyond what I can handle.
say:5:1322402006:1.female: But... what can I even do? The guards might not say it out loud, but we all know Whiteridge's problems are way beyond what I can handle.

say:6:1322402007:1.text: If you could stay in Whiteridge a bit longer, Magister, it would really help us out.
say:6:1322402007:1.source_cn: 如果可以，魔法师大人，您能留在白山一阵子是最好的。
say:6:1322402007:1.male: If you could stay in Whiteridge a bit longer, Magister, it would really help us out.
say:6:1322402007:1.female: If you could stay in Whiteridge a bit longer, Magister, it would really help us out.

say:8:1322402008:1.text: Dura above... Just hearing you say that makes me feel a bit lighter.
say:8:1322402008:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……听到您的这句话，我总觉得了轻松了很多。
say:8:1322402008:1.male: Dura above... Just hearing you say that makes me feel a bit lighter.
say:8:1322402008:1.female: Dura above... Just hearing you say that makes me feel a bit lighter.

say:11:1322402009:1.text: Sorry for unloading all of this on you. I shouldn't have gone on like that...
say:11:1322402009:1.source_cn: 很抱歉把这些压力丢在在您身上，也许我不该说这些的……
say:11:1322402009:1.male: Sorry for unloading all of this on you. I shouldn't have gone on like that...
say:11:1322402009:1.female: Sorry for unloading all of this on you. I shouldn't have gone on like that...

say:12:1322402010:1.text: Rest assured, Whiteridge will never forget those who helped us.
say:12:1322402010:1.source_cn: 您放心，白山从不亏待任何一位朋友。
say:12:1322402010:1.male: Rest assured, Whiteridge will never forget those who helped us.
say:12:1322402010:1.female: Rest assured, Whiteridge will never forget those who helped us.

choice:2:0:1.text: We came to check in on you.
choice:2:0:1.male: We came to check in on you.
choice:2:0:1.female: We came to check in on you.

say:13:1322402003:1.text: Thank you. I'm managing… but honestly, sometimes it feels like this might all just be a bad dream we'll never wake up from.
say:13:1322402003:1.source_cn: 谢谢您，我还撑得住……虽然我总觉得也许现实才是真正的噩...

choice:2:1:2.text: You seem to be doing fine.
choice:2:1:2.male: You seem to be doing fine.
choice:2:1:2.female: You seem to be doing fine.

choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 亚莲娜公主的事我很遗憾
